per_step_verdicts.basis: Multiplicative fingerprint: flat-block per-pixel residual std = 0.091*I+3.2 in the target, identical across all 5 pairs; simulated noise_speckle:3 gives 0.0917*I+3.2 (sev1=0.035, sev2=0.062 both too weak). var_slope=-0.10 rules out Poisson; constant add-noise (Gaussian RGB/YCrCb) rejected (no intensity slope); spatial_corr=0.73 and cross_channel_corr=0.93 follow from the multiplicative field. verify_signals MATCH on 5/5 pairs. Noise step cannot be LIKELY (seed mismatch).
block_boundary target 1.5553 vs simulated 1.569 (0.9%); dct_zero_ratio 0.722 vs 0.724 (0.3%); jpeg severities 1/3/4/5 rejected (6%/32%/75%/152% block_boundary error). Matched on 5/5 support pairs.

analysis.order_basis: noise_speckle precedes compression_jpeg: wavelet sigma of the target (1.98) is far below the per-pixel noise level (~16) because JPEG smooths noise inside 8x8 blocks; a compression-then-noise order would leave a high wavelet sigma and inflate block boundaries.
analysis.support_pairs_validation: 5/5 pairs: verify_signals MATCH, and block_boundary, dct_zero_ratio, noise sigma, variance_ratio, mean_shift, clipped_fraction, contrast_spread_ratio, saturation all within <1% of the target-pair values.
analysis.notes: PSNR 21.80 dB is the noise-seed mismatch floor and is not a validity criterion for the random noise step; CI 10/10.
